scope: Fase de medicao comum aos benchmarks TSDB (IoT-Benchmark, TPCx-IoT, TSBS); RUBiS fora de escopo nesta rodada

repetitions.order: single continuous window per repetition; each round visits every query (seeded shuffle) and, inside each query, every variant in a seeded random permutation reversed on even rounds (counterbalanced)
repetitions.interrupted_window_policy: a repetition whose window is interrupted or violates the isolation guard is discarded entirely and rerun with a new seed (max 2 reruns); the discarded raw data is kept under discarded/

metrics.decision_metric: mean end-to-end client latency of the uniform query mix (unweighted mean of per-class means)
metrics.decision_metric_rationale: p95 of tens of samples is unstable for 1-5 ms queries (IoT Fase 4); the mean is additive over a mix and is the RUBiS V9 metric
metrics.secondary_metric: mean of per-class p95 (comparability with previous campaigns)

statistics.ci: 95% percentile bootstrap on raw latencies, resampling within each (query, repetition) stratum
statistics.paired_contrasts: ratio of mix means between two variants, paired bootstrap that resamples round indices shared by both variants
statistics.noise_floor: A/A pairs (deployments that execute byte-identical work on different keyspaces); noise floor = max over A/A pairs of the upper 95% CI bound of |ln ratio| of the decision metric
statistics.tie_rule: two variants are tied when |ln ratio| < noise floor or the paired CI contains 1

correctness.oracle: layout-independent logical evaluator computed from source rows in memory

physical_state.flush_gate: nodetool flush per measured keyspace after loading; every table SSTable count >= 1 and memtable cell count = 0 before every repetition
physical_state.isolation_guard: sample system_views.sstable_tasks every 15 s during the window (0 active compactions required) and compare system.compaction_history before/after (0 new entries for measured keyspaces)
physical_state.storage: nodetool tablestats 'Space used (live)' per table after flush and compaction settle; summed per deployment
physical_state.write_metric: sequential loader wall time and physical write count per deployment (same loader for all variants)

method_evaluation.reference_space: all admissible deployments measured in verification mode
indicators: Top-1 (selector rank-1 is the measured best, or tied with it)
Top-3 (measured best within the first 3 of HBench)
near-best 5% (HBench contains a deployment within 5% of the measured best)
regret = best measured in HBench / best measured overall - 1
Pareto retention = fraction of the measured Pareto front (read mean, storage bytes, write time) present in HBench
Kendall tau between selector score and measured decision metric

ablations.rule_ablation: neutralize each activation rule TS0..TS8 and each modifier M1..M5, regenerate candidates and rerun the frozen Stage 8 code
ablations.evaluation: measured regret / Top-k of each ablated HBench using verification-mode measurements (no new timing)
